title: /weather <location> answers 'saved as an idea' instead of the forecast

rootCause.summary: The explicit /weather shortcut routes to the weather_query scenario, which depends on the LLM emitting a weather_lookup tool call (direct_output_from_tool short-circuits only AFTER the call). The configured local model (qwen3:30b) sometimes returns no tool call and no final (llm_returned_no_tool_calls_and_no_final), producing OutcomeProviderError. Because weather_query is requires_provenance and the assembler yields empty Sources, the provenance gate rewrites the provider-error into the capture-as-fallback body 'saved as an idea — i'll surface it later.' Geocoding was never the cause (Open-Meteo resolves the ZIP directly).

resolution: Add a deterministic /weather fast-path (facade Step 3.9) that dispatches the weather tool directly for an explicit /weather <location> shortcut, bypassing the LLM loop AND the provenance gate. Extract weather.LookupForecast (shared core of the tool handler) and wire it as a facade seam (WithWeatherLookup). Success renders forecast_line + one SourceExternalProvider; provider failure / empty location render an honest StatusUnavailable/slot_missing line — NEVER the capture-as-fallback acknowledgement. Backward-compatible: the LLM /weather path is untouched when the seam is not wired. Three adversarial unit tests reproduce the pre-fix provider-error and assert the fast-path bypasses it; regression-quality-guard --bugfix PASS.
codeVsDeployment: deployed. The fix (sourceSha d4755abd, incl. the grpc v1.82.1 CVE bump) is built, operator-cosign-signed, deployed, and running on <deploy-host>. Running container digests match the fix build (core sha256:44ed9984, ml sha256:30ea2392), both healthy, and the Telegram assistant adapter is wired and bound. Only the operator's behavioral Telegram smoke test remains (an authenticated HTTP probe returned 401 because prod requires a PASETO session, not the raw shared token).

ONE finding accepted and fixed (S-1): two failure-path test names promised an honest USER-VISIBLE body but bound only the status pair, so an empty Body satisfied every assertion; a body assertion was added to each. This is load-bearing rather than cosmetic here because the defect under repair IS a wrong user-visible body, and because under mutant M1 the executor path also terminates at unavailable/provider_unavailable — so for the ProviderError test the status pair is non-discriminating and its only discriminator was executor.invocations == 0; the body assertion adds a genuine second independent discriminator. ONE finding declined (S-2): extracting a shared weather renderer across handleWeatherShortcut and compiledWeatherResponse was rejected because the two differ on input type, status, Source.ID, strictness and provenance-gate application — the parameterized abstraction would exceed the ~10 duplicated lines and re-couple the fast path to the path it exists to bypass. The duplication that mattered was already removed by the fix itself: LookupForecast is an extraction, not a copy. ONE observation recorded (S-3): the empty-ProviderName branch of handleWeatherShortcut returns StatusAnswered with zero Sources and discards the RetrievedAt parse error, and is untested — but it is unreachable through the wired production path, so it was left unchanged and routed to bubbles.plan rather than hardened with churn on a REGRESSION_FREE packet.
